title: 第18章  金色词条，启程苍云岭
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
【正在合成】

    【嗜血[白]×81→血疗[绿]×27→自愈[蓝]×9→重塑[紫]×3→回生[金]】

    【回生：体内伤势随气血流转极速恢复】

    【注：同一路径下仅可绑定一个词条】

    ......

    金色词条！

    血妖无形无相，受到攻击时拥有着几乎不死的再生能力。

    金词【回生】，其效果就是血妖本源之中最纯粹的生命力。

    这生命力融入陆渊气血之中，只要气血流转，便有生机滋养肉身。

    筋骨断裂，自行愈合；脏腑受创，再生血肉。

    不管受到什么伤势都能极速恢复。

    只要气血不枯，陆渊便不会倒下。

    重点是一个“极”字。

    它可以是快速，也可以是迅速，但它是极速。

    单就这一字之差，说是生死人肉白骨也不为过。

    绑定词条，然后打开词库。

    【当前词库：】

    【红色词条：开天、悟性逆天】

    【金色词条：回生】

    【紫色词条：顿悟、破妄】

    【蓝色词条：明心见性】

    【绿色词条：聪颖×2、明察×2、观灵、血疗×2、燃血】

    【白色词条：灵思×2、夜瞳】

    （不重要的词条合成过程已经略过，大家直接看结果）

    根据现状，短时间内是出不了红色词条了。

    不过眼下两红一金一紫的配置也够用了。

    想到这里，陆渊对于苍云岭之行愈发期待。

    苍云岭在赤霞县以西一百二十里，密林遮天蔽日，常年不见阳光。

    主峰上是终年不散的阴云，当地百姓将那称为尸云。

    路上，苏定安向陆渊讲述起昨夜查到的线索。
content_en:
【Synthesizing】

    [Bloodthirsty [White] × 81 → Blood Healing [Green] × 27 → Self-Healing [Blue] × 9 → Reshape [Purple] × 3 → Resurrection [Gold]]

    [Resurrection: Injuries in the body recover quickly with the flow of Qi and blood]

    [Note: Only one entry can be bound to the same path]

    ...

    Golden entry!

    The blood demon is invisible and has the ability to regenerate almost immortally when attacked.

    The effect of the golden word [resurrection] is the purest vitality in the origin of the blood demon.

    This vitality is integrated into Lu Yuan's qi and blood. As long as the qi and blood circulate, there will be vitality to nourish the physical body.

    When muscles and bones are broken, they heal on their own; when organs are injured, they regenerate flesh and blood.

    No matter what kind of injury you suffer, you can recover quickly.

    As long as his energy and blood don't dry up, Lu Yuan will not fall.

    The key point is the word "extreme".

    It can be fast, it can be quick, but it is fast.

    Just by the difference of one word, it is not an exaggeration to say that it is human flesh and bones.

    Bind the term and open the dictionary.

    【Current thesaurus:】

    [Red entries: Open Heaven, Comprehension Defying Heaven]

    [Golden Entry: Resurrection]

    [Purple entries: enlightenment, destruction of delusion]

    [Blue entry: Understanding the mind and seeing the nature]

    [Green entries: Intelligence × 2, Insight × 2, Observation of Spirits, Blood Therapy × 2, Burning Blood]

    [White entries: Lingsi × 2, Night Eye]

    (The unimportant entry synthesis process has been skipped, and everyone will look directly at the results)

    According to the current situation, red entries will no longer be available in a short period of time.

    But the current configuration of two red, one gold and one purple is enough.

    Thinking of this, Lu Yuan became more and more looking forward to the trip to Cangyun Ridge.

    Cangyun Ridge is located 120 miles west of Chixia County. The dense forest blocks the sky and the sun, and there is no sunshine all year round.

    There are dark clouds that linger all year round on the main peak, which the local people call corpse clouds.

    On the way, Su Ding'an told Lu Yuan about the clues found last night.
title_en: Chapter 18 Golden Entry, Departure to Cangyun Ridge
